changes: scripts/promote-dist.mjs: exported restoreBinExecutableBits(dist) runs after every dist promotion and chmods each package.json bin target (ENOENT / no bin / unparseable package.json are no-ops), so the global proof-or-stop symlink keeps working after rebuilds (tsc emits 0644; npm link chmods only once). packages/main/src/core/runtime-environment-checks.ts: checkGlobalCoreRealpath reports realpath, version, bin mode and executable flag, warns with the exact repoint command when the global install resolves into a .worktrees/ checkout, with chmod +x when the bin target is not executable, and with the rebuild command when it is absent; no global install is informational. packages/main/tests/global-core-realpath.test.mjs: cases 4-8 cover those branches. packages/main/tests/red/red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs: registered red test with hermetic cases for restoreBinExecutableBits. Cherry-picked B-83aa 8ebfff3550 so validation-tier-planner-smoke F-023 no longer pins the whole-repository commandSetDigest.
usage: No new command. After npm --prefix packages/main run build, ls -la packages/main/dist/cli.js shows -rwxr-xr-x and proof-or-stop --version works; proof-or-stop doctor prints the global-core-realpath row with realpath, version, mode and executable flag. Regression: node packages/main/tests/red/red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs and node packages/main/tests/global-core-realpath.test.mjs.
expectedOutcome: Rebuilds keep the global bin target executable and doctor names the drift with an exact remediation; the red test prints GREEN red-global-cli-exec-bit: rebuilds keep the global bin target executable.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/tests/red/red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs in the story worktree -> hermetic (a)/(b)/(c) GREEN and the final GREEN line, exit 0; RED_REPO_ROOT=<main checkout> -> RED red-global-cli-exec-bit: 5 desired properties not met, exit 1; node packages/main/tests/global-core-realpath.test.mjs -> ok global-core-realpath (8 cases); node packages/main/dist/cli.js doctor -> global-core-realpath [hard] /Users/jek/Documents/GitHub/Prooforstop/packages/main version=0.3.271 mode=0755 executable=yes. Round-2 reviewers proved cases 7/8 by mutation.
outcomeDiff: No difference between expected and actual.
limitations: Doctor reports and recommends; it never repairs the host global install. The earlier draft symptom (link resolving into .worktrees/B-fe8f) is machine state and is covered by the doctor warning plus a fixture, not by a red test of the live host.
pitfalls: restoreBinExecutableBits runs inside promoteDist for both main and utils builds; a package that declares bin as a string shorthand is handled, a non-object bin value is ignored. Mode bits are not part of the content-bound build binding, so a second build still takes the fast path.
